0022600216.text: The Trail Blazers host the Oklahoma City Thunder in Portland's 10th game of the season. Portland (6-3) is 3rd in the Northwest, 1.5 games back, and 8th in the West, with a 1-2 home record and a two-game losing streak, while Oklahoma City (8-2) leads the Northwest, sits 2nd in the West, and is on a four-game winning streak with a 5-0 home record. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Trail Blazers lost the season series 1-3, including a 124-95 loss in Oklahoma City on December 31, 2025. Portland is missing Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), and Vit Krejci (ankle), and Oklahoma City is missing Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Jaylin Williams (back spasms), and Thomas Sorber (knee).
